description: Reference table of all sales channels through which tickets are sold. Each channel is owned by a specific platform (platform_id FK). channel_type categorises channels as DIRECT, PARTNER, or VENDOR — the three-way split that drives channel attribution in the Gold layer. Cleaned and deduplicated in silver_channels (incremental, active-only). Consumed by: silver_channels → gold_ticket_sales_daily, gold_regional_summary, gold_channel_performance (CIO channel strategy dashboard).

fields.name: channel_id
fields.description: Surrogate key for the sales channel. Primary key — tested with not_null and unique in sources.yml. Referenced as FK from raw_ticketing.tickets.channel_id. Core join key for all channel attribution in Silver and Gold layers.

fields.name: channel_name
fields.description: Human-readable channel name e.g. Mobile App, Website, Partner Portal, Third Party Vendor. Standardised to INITCAP in silver_channels. Exposed as a dimension in gold_ticket_sales_daily and gold_channel_performance.

fields.name: channel_type
fields.description: Category of the channel. Accepted values: DIRECT | PARTNER | VENDOR. Standardised to UPPER in silver_channels. Drives the direct_vs_partner_vs_vendor_split metric in gold_regional_summary and the channel_revenue_share_pct breakdown in gold_channel_performance.

fields.name: channel_description
fields.description: Free-text description of the channel and its operational context. Passed through to silver_channels as-is (trimmed).

fields.name: platform_id
fields.description: FK to raw_ticketing.platforms.platform_id. Identifies which platform owns and operates this channel. Relationship tested in sources.yml. Used to join silver_channels to silver_platforms in gold_channel_performance.

fields.name: is_active
fields.description: Whether this channel is currently live and accepting ticket sales. silver_channels filters to is_active = TRUE only, so inactive channels are excluded from all Silver and Gold models.

fields.name: launch_date
fields.description: Date when this channel went live. Cast to DATE in silver_channels. Used to derive channel_age_days = DATE_DIFF(CURRENT_DATE, launch_date, DAY) in silver_channels.

fields.name: ingested_at
fields.description: UTC timestamp when this record was written to BigQuery by the ingestion pipeline. Used as the incremental predicate in silver_channels (3-day lookback window).
